notes.title: v1.01 Patch (March 28th)
notes.content:
The following issues have been addressed and fixed as of the current update:

- Fixed the issue where the controls get fixated to 1P (keyboard) upon accepting a network invitation from outside of the network mode. Now, upon entering the network mode via a friend's invitation, the controls will be determined by the key pressed at the first prompt.

- Fixed issues where players experience desynchronizations in network battles.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: Chaos Code -New Sign of Catastrophe- bifs onto PC
notes.content: For years, the PC was short of fighting games. The bigguns stayed in arcades and on consoles, our home-grown ones were a bit wonky, and we certainly didn’t have Salty Bet. Now, goodness me, we’ve more fights than a pub car park. Along with (most of) the big-name series, loads of neat smaller games, we get the odd games too, such as Chaos Code -New Sign of Catastrophe- [official site]. FK Digital’s fight ’em up arrived on PC last week, with a cast ranging from a manga artist to a chef. Have a look: … [visit site to read more]
